description.translate: I've been studying mechanical workshops. Shafts, gears, steam engines... Clever stuff. Dangerous too, if you don't respect it. Bring me twelve copper ingots. I want to rebuild the damaged fittings before trying anything ambitious.

Good copper. That's a start. There was a professor who came through here months ago, asking about strange underground signals. I laughed him out of the workshop. I'm beginning to think I owe the man an apology.
